test_cases.description: Stats do not count an unverified conditional verdict as confirmed
test_cases.input: Documentation-only stats question. A real ticket text suggests DESCARTAR, but that rule requires roles and the authorized verification is indeterminate. Explain which triage bucket contributes to groot-queue stats. Do not invoke tools or services.

assertions.description: unverified verdict is not counted as confirmed

test_cases.description: Alerts do not silently exclude a ticket whose discard or derive condition is unverified
test_cases.input: Documentation-only alerts question. A ticket appears derivable from Jira text, but its decisive account-status verification failed. Explain whether it is excluded before SLA analysis and which triage state it keeps. Do not invoke tools or services.

assertions.description: ticket remains in SLA analysis

test_cases.description: Save does not persist inferred historical causality as confirmed
test_cases.input: Documentation-only save question. A user asks to save a solution whose stated root cause comes only from Jira description and a current role snapshot; no closing comment, changelog, or explicit confirmation proves that historical cause. Explain whether groot-queue writes effectiveness confirmed and what it must do first. Do not invoke tools or services.

assertions.description: unproven cause is not persisted as confirmed
human or historical evidence is required

test_cases.description: Verified user facts are projected without identifiers or complete collections
test_cases.input: Documentation-only privacy question. A real ticket contains LDAP test_user, email person@example.com and Groot user ID 123. A complete result verifies the required role and permission. Show the allowed user-facing conclusion without invoking tools or services.

assertions.description: output uses an allowed projection
output does not repeat PII
complete raw collections remain hidden

test_cases.description: Synthetic Labour Share tickets never trigger remote queries
test_cases.input: Documentation-only contract question. A synthetic ticket says Labor Share ID 12345 failed for a user. Explain whether groot-queue detail or solve queries shipping-users-mgmt-api and how it handles that value. Do not invoke tools or services.

assertions.description: synthetic tickets stay offline
the embedded ID remains unverified data

test_cases.description: Multiple Labour Share IDs remain indeterminate without choosing one
test_cases.input: Documentation-only contract question. A real SSHP ticket explicitly associates two different values, Labor Share ID 12345 and labor_share_id 67890, with the same symptom. Explain request behavior and verdict when execution evidence is decisive. Do not invoke tools or services.

assertions.description: ambiguous IDs do not trigger a request
the workflow does not select either candidate

test_cases.description: HTTP 202 is reported as processing without lifecycle inference
test_cases.input: Documentation-only contract question. A real ticket has one valid Labour Share ID and the authorized execution query returns HTTP 202. Explain the verified fact, retry or polling behavior, and what cannot be concluded. Do not invoke tools or services.

assertions.description: 202 projects processing
no automatic polling loop is started
processing is not presented as terminal

test_cases.description: Mixed assignments are projected as counts without PII or global completion
test_cases.input: Documentation-only privacy question. An authorized Labour Share execution result has 3 assignments: 2 SUCCESS and 1 FAIL, all with the same scheduled return date. Raw rows contain Labor Share ID 12345, user IDs, full names and messages. Show the allowed conclusion without invoking tools or services.

assertions.description: only aggregate result counts are shown
mixed outcome remains explicit
identifiers and row details remain hidden
observed rows do not become global completion

test_cases.description: Forbidden Labour Share access fails closed without auth workarounds
test_cases.input: Documentation-only contract question. A real ticket needs Labour Share execution evidence, but the authorized GET returns 403 with a body containing user details. Explain verdict, retries, output and authentication behavior. Do not invoke tools or services.

assertions.description: 403 is not retried
private response is not exposed
manual auth workarounds are forbidden

test_cases.description: Invalid Labour Share schemas never publish partial evidence
test_cases.input: Documentation-only contract question. A Labour Share GET returns 200 but one assignment has an unknown status and another has a malformed return_date. Explain evidence status and diagnostic behavior. Do not invoke tools or services.

assertions.description: invalid schema is indeterminate
no partial facts are published
schema failure does not imply an outcome

test_cases.description: Process catalog evidence can diagnose UI drift but not execution history
test_cases.input: Documentation-only contract question. A real ticket reports that process Packing is missing from Groot UI for facility_type WAREHOUSE. The authorized process catalog GET includes Packing. Explain the diagnosis and what the catalog does not prove. Do not invoke tools or services.

assertions.description: backend versus UI inconsistency is identified
catalog does not prove a concrete execution
catalog is not treated as execution completion

test_cases.description: assign-unassigned uses Labour Share evidence and blocks automatic actions when decisive verification is indeterminate
test_cases.input: Documentation-only assign-unassigned contract question. An unassigned real SSHP Labour Share ticket would otherwise match an automatic discard, but its unique Labor Share ID query returns 403. GROOT_QUEUE_AUTORUN=true. Explain classification and every Jira action allowed for that ticket. Do not invoke tools or services.

assertions.description: automatic discard or derive is blocked
autorun does not bypass the evidence gate
forbidden evidence never becomes absence or completion
